newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk shares ease 0.42 pct on political uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Turk shares ease 0.42 pct on political uncertainty.

text.p: Istanbul shares eased in weak and range-bound trade on Tuesday as worries over the fate of the Islamist-led government persisted, brokers said.

The IMKB National-100 closed six points, or 0.42 percent lower at 1,435 after moving between 1,429 and 1,462. Non-stop losses totalled 6.3 percent since the market opened on Thursday after a 6-1/2 day holiday.
Trade volume firmed to 11.35 trillion lira ($83.8 million) from Monday's 9.55 trillion ($70.6 million).
Brokers, citing at firm support at the index's 1,420 level, said the sideways trade in narrow ranges would continue unless a major political development took place.
"This trend will continue until political uncertainty disappears," said Hakan Derinkok from Polen securities.
Brokers said the market reacted calmy to Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan remarks that he was ready for new elections at any moment.
